input: q4-route-30x7.json (full local experiment archive; not included in this compact directory)

conventions.per_run: Arithmetic mean across the 30 fixed geometries. All runs completed.
conventions.per_source: Pooled across source appearances in different scenes; 360 per variant, not 360 physically unique locations.
conventions.success_rate: direction/near successes divided by actual nth followup attempts; no attempt means null.
conventions.delay: first direction reply to first followup start; add 5 seconds for followup reply.
conventions.no_remeasure: first-direction sources cleared without any subsequent radio measurement; not censored failures.
conventions.J: Numerically sampled pure-P diameter score over finite candidate sets; not a continuous worst-case bound.
conventions.CPU: Process CPU includes warmup/initialization, measured in a four-worker run; distinct from elapsed wall time.
conventions.statistics: Descriptive paired results only; no distributional or universal performance claim.

recommendation.basis: Lowest mean complete task time among the seven tested configurations; descriptive only.
limitations: Budget1 thresholds0/20 not tested: no joint parameter optimum established.
Budget2 reduces clear attempts but is slower on average in this batch.
Long first-remeasurement waits remain; scheduling is not a latency guarantee.
